_help: Policy read by security/scan.py. Changing it widens what the scanner accepts, so every change goes through a PR reviewed by CODEOWNERS. Exceptions for single findings go in security/allowlist.json, not here.
code_scope_rationale: Everything an installation copies or runs. No script in these folders may touch the network, read the user's home or credentials, or start a shell.

instruction_files.rationale: Markdown an agent reads as instructions. Prompt-injection and URL rules apply to these.

doc_domains_rationale: A URL in an instruction file or in distributable code whose host is not one of these (or a subdomain) is reported MEDIUM so a reviewer looks at it. Paste sites, raw-file hosts, tunnels, webhooks, shorteners and IP addresses are HIGH regardless (see scan.py BAD_HOSTS).

cartographer.role: maps folders; Bash/PowerShell only to run map_context.py; never writes case files

researcher.role: the only agent allowed on the web; writes only context/RESEARCH.md and research-data.json

executor.role: builds one input and runs one method script

auditor.role: re-runs scripts in a temp folder; writes only context/AUDIT.md

agent_tools_rationale: An agent file not listed here, an agent without a tools: line (it would inherit every tool, MCP tools included) or a tool outside its list is HIGH.
install_roots_rationale: The documented install targets (docs/INSTALL.md, install/platforms.json with its sources). Any other {HOME}/{LOCALAPPDATA} target in platforms.json is HIGH.
fixtures_rationale: Globs where binary office files (xlsx, xls, pdf, zip, docx) are allowed as documented test fixtures. Empty: the repo ships none.
